content.rationale: S2-id fixes the boundary — only a validated id derives a path, so an unparseable id never becomes a filesystem probe; S2-path fixes the layout — a node document is nodes/<id>.json, derived from the id alone, with no index or second layout; D1b makes the id the owning change id. It parses the id and derives nodes/<id>.json — nothing else; because it needs neither the runner nor the read it is the one derivation both the read and the write call. Document validity is M-node-load's.
